purpose.zh: 拉开后腿胯前面和前腿大腿内侧
purpose.en: Stretches the front of your back hip and the inner thigh of your front leg.

text.en: Let your hips sink slowly forward and down

text.zh: 前脚远远踩在前面，后膝跪地，两手扶砖。
text.en: Front foot far forward, back knee down, hands on the blocks.

text.zh: 两手撑在前脚里面，后膝着地，胯往下沉。
text.en: Hands inside your front foot, back knee down, hips sinking.

text.zh: 呼气时胯再往地上沉一点，够了就换小臂撑。
text.en: Each breath out, sink your hips lower. Drop to your forearms only if it feels easy.

commonErrors.zh: 前膝往里倒或远远超过脚尖
commonErrors.en: Front knee caving in or drifting far past your toes.

commonErrors.zh: 前脚往里收，前膝往里倒
commonErrors.en: Front foot creeping in and the knee falling inward.

cautions.zh: 跪着的膝盖下面垫软垫
胯或大腿内侧疼就沉少点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your hip or inner thigh hurts, don't sink as far. Stop if it still hurts.
